scoring.manual_review_note: manual_review_case_ids are flagged for audit, but no human verdicts are stored; summary metrics use automatic scores only

mean_agent_minus_rag_ci95.method: normal approximation over per-case mean differences

statistics.proportion_ci95: Wilson score interval per round; see groups.*.per_round
statistics.paired_difference_ci95: mean +/- 1.96 * sample_sd / sqrt(cases) over per-case mean differences (normal approximation)
statistics.usage_note: A model call with total_tokens=0 is counted as missing usage; total_tokens is a known lower bound, never zero-imputed.
statistics.denominator_note: Every round uses the full case list; terminal failures are retained in accuracy denominators.
